Mobile means a resized desktop browser; the original final mobile run includes a new navigation, while CSS mobile paint data refers to its earlier desktop navigation.

initialNavigationOutlier: CSS desktop first navigation reported FCP 7480 ms; DNS started at 7297.1 ms. Observed delay before the request, cause not proven. Subsequent navigation FCP was 184 ms. Both observations are retained.
optimizationDecision: Forced animation of the padded original SVG drawings measured p95 33.4 ms and a 100 ms maximum frame. This optional hover animation was removed. The shipped original uses static cards with working dialog interactions; final mobile scrolling measured p95 16.7 ms, maximum 16.8 ms. The CSS edition retains hover motion with p95 16.8 ms.
interpretation: Both editions' mobile scrolling measured about 60 fps on this PC. CSS desktop enlarged-card measurements ranged 29.5–133.2 ms; original desktop before hover removal ranged 13–249.5 ms. Original final mobile ranged 11.6–121.8 ms. There is a measurable initial rendering cost; no claim of zero latency or guaranteed performance on other hardware/Safari.
visualAcceptance: Reference row geometry, colors, themes, ratings, positions, stats and country flags recreated. Illustration detail differs from the reference; not pixel-identical or an undisputed bet win.
verifiedInteractions: Escape closes dialogs and restores scrolling
